## Details

<a id="motion_ptrs"></a>
### [`motion_ptrs`](../../../../src/sprites/sprite_motions.asm#L6) `$CCE3-$CCFA`

*data*

Pointers to the sprite motions $00-$0b. The motion number is in $025a,x (bit 7 set).

- **Read by:** [`run_sprite_script`](sprite_script.md#run_sprite_script)

<a id="motion_00"></a>
### [`motion_00`](../../../../src/sprites/sprite_motions.asm#L11) `$CCFB-$CCFF`

*data*

Sprite motion: steps of 4 bytes. Directions (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right), speeds (high nibble X, low nibble Y), frames, command. Commands: 0 next step, 1 new motion and animation follow, 2 new motion follows, 3 step follows, 4 stops. Other values: a sound request follows.

- **Entry of:** [`motion_ptrs`](../../tables.md#motion_ptrs)
